g.text: Repeat alternating CdSe and PerCA4 exposures
Assemble CdSe/PerCA4 multilayers on PVBH-primed ITO
ACTION
Repeat the alternating baths to build the source-defined multilayers. Figure 1
reports n=1–5 optical growth, while the thickness statement concerns n=10. These
contexts do not define a shared physical batch or an interpolated thickness law.
CONDITIONS
duration per exposure: 5 min — Each alternating bath exposure; not total film
preparation time
ENVIRONMENT
Not reported
INPUTS
Expose the CdSe-coated substrate to PerCA4 solution — output; Preformed CdSe
nanocrystals in chloroform; PerCA4 in ethanol
OUTPUT
Source-defined CdSe/PerCA4 multilayer film (count selected by context)
CdSe bath
PerCA4 bath
Alternation; count selected by source
context
Conceptual alternating deposition sequence on a flat substrate; no exact layer count, molecular
orientation or nanocrystal packing is rendered.
SOURCE: Main PDF p.3, Section 3.2, CdSe/PerCA4 Multilayers and Figure 1; Main PDF p.2, Section 2.2, Substrates
and Multilayer Film Formation
